purpose: Prevent an execution turn from returning control at an intermediate milestone or logical-operation boundary while authorized work or the active execution envelope remains nonterminal.

execution.persists_until: bounded unit completed_verified plus terminal execution envelope, genuine blocker, or newer owner command

status_and_continue.persists_until: same boundary as execution after the concise status

keep_going.persists_until: owner-named boundary plus terminal execution envelope, genuine blocker, or newer owner command

get_ready.persists_until: preparation is complete; substantive implementation remains reserved

permitted_final_response_reasons: bounded unit is completed_verified, required successor selection is complete, and execution envelope is terminal
a classified genuine blocker with current evidence survived reasonable recovery and blocks all authorized progress
the owner explicitly selected get_ready, status_only, or analysis_only
nonterminal_conditions: implementation exists but current exact-head validation has not passed
current exact-head validation or another required asynchronous operation is queued or running
the governed pull request is open, ready, or awaiting merge
merge succeeded but canonical closeout or successor selection is pending
application merge succeeded and AIOC closeout is only partially assembled
one meaningful substep or tool-call batch ended
a logical operation completed while execution envelope phase is fill or closeout
a closed execution envelope has not reached the canonical target and safe same-lane work was not explicitly exhausted after dynamic fill
a status summary could be written while execution authority remains
anticipated response length, token pressure, context pressure, tool-call count, or self-imposed execution budget while authorized tools remain callable
the executor has enough capability to emit a final response but has not run and obeyed a fresh termination preflight

explicit_machine_state.rule: Open PR, active current-head validation, merged-with-closeout-pending, nonterminal envelope phase, unproven early exit, or pre-target normal closeout independently blocks final response even if pending_authorized_steps is empty.

execution_envelope_integrity.cycle_rule: One owner Continue owns one execution envelope. Logical operations are phases or work units inside that envelope and do not create new cycles.
execution_envelope_integrity.fill_rule: While phase=fill and safe same-lane work exists, operation completion selects the next safe operation.
execution_envelope_integrity.closeout_rule: At active minute 16, optional expansion stops and shared closeout begins inside the same cycle.
execution_envelope_integrity.normal_terminal_rule: Normal closure requires phase=closed, closeout_complete=true and at least 24 active minutes using the canonical 24/16 timing values.
execution_envelope_integrity.early_terminal_rule: Before 24 minutes, closure requires fill_exit_reason=safe_work_exhausted, safe_same_lane_work_available=false and dynamic_fill_attempted=true.
execution_envelope_integrity.resume_rule: Conversation change, context compaction, operation completion or recovery does not reset cycle identity or elapsed envelope state.

blocker_integrity.rule: A genuine blocker is an externally evidenced inability to make any remaining authorized progress, not an executor preference to stop.
forbidden_self_classifications: tool execution cut off without a concrete platform rejection
blocker_integrity.platform_usage_ceiling_rule: Only a concrete platform/tool rejection or explicit usage-ceiling signal that actually prevents all remaining authorized progress may be environment_unavailable.
blocker_integrity.callable_tool_rule: If any pending authorized closeout, merge, verification, successor or dynamic-fill step remains callable through an available governed tool or fallback, execution must continue.

runtime_enforcement.mandatory_invocation_rule: Every execution-mode final response requires a fresh preflight result. Skipping preflight is itself a control-plane incident and never creates a legitimate tranche boundary.
runtime_enforcement.execution_envelope_rule: Completed logical work does not close the cycle. The termination preflight evaluates execution_envelope before allowing completed_verified to return.
runtime_enforcement.branch_pr_collision_rule: After governed start and before application mutation, supply the fresh authorized branch/open-PR snapshot to execution_transaction_preflight.py. Resume the exact authorized branch or PR when present; an alternate branch or duplicate PR is a control-plane incident and must not be created.
runtime_enforcement.start_projection_rule: Before application branch creation or mutation, checkpoint, pointer, authority, runtime and compiled-roadmap start projections must agree on work item, attempt, state and implementation authority; branch-bearing projections must agree on the authorized branch.
runtime_enforcement.exact_head_rule: Only validation evidence whose validated head equals the current candidate head counts toward closeout. Evidence for a superseded head is automatically non-counting.
runtime_enforcement.closeout_precompute_rule: While exact-head validation is active, the executor may precompute checkpoint/successor/pointer/authority/runtime/compiled/backlog closeout shapes, but must leave validation/receipt/merge evidence unfilled until observed. Fabricated placeholder evidence is forbidden.
runtime_enforcement.one_continue_outcome_rule: Every newly completed governed execution unit records owner_continue_turns, single_continue_achieved and execution_incident. A second bare Continue without a genuine blocker must be visible as an execution incident and cannot be reported as a one-Continue success.
runtime_enforcement.interrupted_closeout_rule: If a prior response returned after application merge with canonical closeout/successor work pending and no externally verified all-progress blocker, the next execution turn must reconcile that stale state before unrelated work and record the incident in convergence evidence.
runtime_enforcement.merge_reserve_rule: Before an application merge, stage the cross-repository closeout and retain enough observable execution reserve to verify the merge, reconcile canonical state and select the strict successor. If a platform usage warning makes that reserve unavailable, leave the validated pull request open.
runtime_enforcement.environment_interruption_handoff: A verified platform usage ceiling may permit a truthful blocked handoff while pending authorized steps remain, but those steps and current envelope recovery point must be preserved explicitly and resumed before unrelated work.
runtime_enforcement.ephemeral_state_rule: Turn-state inputs are temporary execution evidence and are not committed as activity logs. Durable checkpoint updates remain milestone-only; an unexpected environment interruption after a merge or before envelope closure requires a material handoff checkpoint.
